record-google-meet-call.0: Knowing how to record a Google Meet call sounds simple until the record button is missing. Whether it appears depends on three things (your plan, your admin's settings and your device), and plenty of personal Gmail users never see the option at all.
record-google-meet-call.4: Files land in the organizer's Google Drive, inside a "Google Meet" folder with one sub-folder per meeting, and a link also arrives by email, both to the organizer and to whoever pressed record.
record-google-meet-call.9: Tell people before you hit record. Meet displays a notice whenever its own recorder runs, but third-party screen recorders stay silent, which leaves the announcement to you, and several US states require every participant's consent.
record-google-meet-call.10: Android users get built-in recording through the same Meeting tools menu, provided the plan allows it, but iPhone is different: Google's help center says recording only works on a computer or Android device. So iOS lacks the option entirely.
record-google-meet-call.25: In the meeting organizer's Google Drive, inside a "Google Meet" folder with a sub-folder for each meeting. An email with the link goes to the organizer and to whoever started recording, and capture ends automatically after 8 hours or when everyone leaves.
